_note: Product classification lookup for the CRA instrument, verified from Annex III (important products, Class I and II) and Annex IV (critical products). The consultant matches the product under assessment to a category; the tool derives the class and drives the P3 conformity route. If no category matches, the product is Default. Category text paraphrased from the annexes; verbatim not reproduced.

routeByClass.default: Internal control (Module A, Annex VIII Part I): manufacturer self-assessment. No notified body required.
routeByClass.important-class-i: May self-assess ONLY if harmonised standards / common specs / a substantial-level EU certification scheme are applied in full; otherwise EU-type examination (Module B) + conformity to type (Module C), or full quality assurance (Module H).
routeByClass.important-class-ii: Notified-body route required: EU-type examination (Module B) + Module C, or full quality assurance (Module H). Self-assessment not available.
routeByClass.critical: As Class II, and may also be required to obtain a European cybersecurity certificate under an EU scheme where a delegated act so specifies.

annex-iii-class-i.text: Identity management systems and privileged access management software and hardware, including authentication and access control readers (including biometric readers)
Software that searches for, removes or quarantines malicious software
Products with the function of a virtual private network (VPN)
Security information and event management (SIEM) systems
Public key infrastructure and digital certificate issuance software
Routers, modems intended for connection to the internet, and switches
ASICs and FPGAs with security-related functionalities
Smart home general purpose virtual assistants
Smart home products with security functionalities (smart door locks, security cameras, baby monitoring, alarm systems)
Internet-connected toys with social interactive features or location tracking
Personal wearable health-monitoring products outside the EU medical device regulations, or wearables intended for children

annex-iii-class-ii.text: Hypervisors and container runtime systems supporting virtualised execution of operating systems
Firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems

annex-iv.text: Smart meter gateways within smart metering systems, and other devices for advanced security purposes including secure cryptoprocessing
Smartcards or similar devices, including secure elements

classifierFlags: If the product matches BOTH a Class I/II and an Annex IV category, the higher (critical) classification governs.
Flag explicitly where a product the manufacturer assumed was Default appears in Annex III or IV: a common and consequential misclassification that changes the conformity route.
A component integrated into a larger product may itself be an important/critical product; classify the product being placed on the market.
